clue.text: Rapid decline restricting soldiers in fight

indicators.note: the long phrase holds the soldiers within its bounds, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a free fall is a sudden steep drop, as in prices
OR, other ranks, is the usual abbreviation for ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops caught in a sudden collapse during a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: A brawl where everyone joins in is a fight with no rules or sides.

clue.text: A little devil turning up, a blood-sucker

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the pieces are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: an elf is a small mischievous sprite

explanation.surface: An imp flips over and turns out to be a vampire.
explanation.definitionFit: This tiny jumping insect feeds on the blood of mammals and birds.

clue.text: Near a chemist? This pain may be containable there

indicators.note: the letters sought can be held within the run of words named just before

explanation.surface: Ear trouble might be treatable at a nearby pharmacy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'containable there' points back at 'Near a chemist', where the letters sit inside, so the clue is its own hiding place.
explanation.definitionFit: A throbbing in the auditory organ is a kind of ache, a pain one might seek a pharmacist about.

clue.text: Writer in car meeting frenzied beast when coming to river crossing

parts.note: the Ford is a well-known make of car
mad means wild or frenzied
an ox is a beast of burden
a ford is a shallow place to cross a river

explanation.surface: An author in a car runs into a crazed animal at a river.
explanation.walkthrough: Ford Madox Ford was an English novelist, author of The Good Soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: He was an English novelist and editor of the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Observed to be twisted inside — hence given a new assessment

indicators.note: the middle of the word for observed gets a letter shifted, a twist within it

parts.note: regarded means looked at or observed

explanation.surface: Something seen as warped is reassessed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be twisted inside' moves the A of REGARDED one place earlier, past the R.
explanation.definitionFit: To be rated again is to be marked on a fresh scale, as with an exam.

clue.text: Criminal meeting seaman in port

parts.note: a lag is slang for a convict, especially an old lag
OS stands for ordinary seaman

explanation.surface: A crook meets a sailor at the docks.
explanation.walkthrough: LAGOS is the chief port of Nigeria.
explanation.definitionFit: This Nigerian city is a major harbour on the Atlantic coast.

clue.text: Boy carries nothing in pack

indicators.note: the boy holds the next piece within him, as one carries a thing

parts.note: lad means boy
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A lad has an empty rucksack.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean a burden carried, or to fill up with goods.

clue.text: It's improper pinching silver? It's scandalous!

indicators.note: to pinch is to steal and hold, so one piece is taken inside another

parts.note: outre means unconventional or beyond propriety
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Stealing silver is wrong and shocking.
explanation.walkthrough: OUTRE is borrowed French for shockingly unconventional.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation that something is scandalous is the cry of an affront, a shocking act.

clue.text: Any spiders must be disposed of in medical establishment

indicators.note: disposed here hints at being arranged differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clinic must get rid of any spiders.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where drugs are made up and handed out, or a clinic, is a medical establishment.

clue.text: Hesitation by bishop to admit old heresy

parts.note: er is a sound of hesitation

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

explanation.surface: A dithering bishop confesses to an old heresy.
explanation.definitionFit: Heresy is departure from accepted doctrine, a mistaken belief.

clue.text: Performance by a Victorian artist showing great power

parts.note: a gig is a live musical performance
G F Watts was a Victorian painter and sculptor

explanation.surface: A Victorian painter puts on a show displaying huge strength.
explanation.definitionFit: Billions of watts make a measure of enormous electrical output.

clue.text: Court silly gal? The thing she's after may be dreamy

parts.note: to court is to woo

indicators.note: silly suggests the letters of the word gal are jumbled

parts.note: the girl being wooed wants an engagement ring

explanation.surface: A man woos a foolish girl, whose aim is marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lost in idle reverie, daydreaming, is a dreamy state.

clue.text: Sympathetic and merciful, striking a monastic pose

indicators.note: to strike a pose is to adopt one, and here it signals the letters being rearranged

explanation.surface: A monk adopts a kind, forgiving stance.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling pity and showing mercy are the marks of a kind heart.

clue.text: Characters in Paris — tarts, naughty performers

indicators.note: naughty suggests misbehaving letters, rearranged from their order

explanation.surface: Prostitutes in Paris behave badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters in' points to the letters of the words that follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Hip-hop musicians who chant rhymes are a kind of performer.

clue.text: Wild deer in a highland location — but surely not in this city?

indicators.note: in places the anagram within the other pieces

parts.note: a ben is a Scottish mountain

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of the word deer run free

explanation.surface: Feral deer roam a mountain, though hardly in a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild' turns DEER into ERDE, which goes inside A BEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite-built Aberdeen is a Scottish city on the North Sea coast.

clue.text: Shakes hands befouled with grease

indicators.note: befouled means messed up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Greasy handshakes are messy.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaking hands seals a deal, so to do so is to come to terms.

clue.text: Do badger someone to provide information

parts.note: to badger is to pester

explanation.surface: Keep nagging an informant.
explanation.definitionFit: This is old slang for a tipster who supplies inside information, as at the races.

clue.text: Additional building girl found by river

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
the Exe is a river in Devon, England

explanation.surface: An extension where a woman lives beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: An extension or outbuilding added to a main structure.

clue.text: Raced up gaining speed to give an account

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: ran means raced
rate means speed

explanation.surface: Rushing upward, speeding up, to tell a story.
explanation.definitionFit: To tell a story is to give an account of events.

clue.text: Bed exceptionally great — but will his dwelling be able to accommodate it?

definitions.text: his dwelling be able to accommodate it

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: exceptionally hints at letters out of their normal order

explanation.surface: A huge bed, but would a small house fit it?
explanation.walkthrough: 'exceptionally' turns GREAT into TAGER. The definition is whimsical: the tail asks whether the owner of a cottage has room for the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A rustic dweller lives in a small country house.

clue.text: Rubbish sack dumped in French station

indicators.note: dumped in means put inside

parts.note: gare is French for railway station
a bag is a sack

explanation.surface: A bag of trash left at a Paris railway terminal.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste or refuse is rubbish.

clue.text: Award-winning performance that's climax of hogmanay celebration

definitions.meaning: a turn is a performance, and 'of the year' is the style of awards
Hogmanay is the Scottish New Year's Eve, whose high point is midnight

explanation.surface: A prize-winning act tops off Scottish New Year's Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: A turn is a stage act given an annual award; also the moment one calendar period gives way to the next.

clue.text: Old couple I want to relocate

indicators.note: to relocate is to move, so the letters move about

explanation.surface: I want to move an elderly pair.
explanation.definitionFit: This archaic word means two, a pair.

clue.text: Colour fade, we hear, with sun

definitions.note: the definition is a verb, colours

indicators.note: we hear signals a word that sounds like another

parts.note: to die away is to fade
S is short for sun, as in Sunday

explanation.surface: Colour fading in sunlight.
explanation.definitionFit: To stain fabric is to colour it.

clue.text: Refuse to give up as good person and go on hunger strike?

parts.note: a saint, ST, is the crossword good person
to fast is to refuse food

explanation.surface: A virtuous protester refuses food.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold one's ground without yielding.

clue.text: Country current, rill finally entering river

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: entering means going into

parts.note: the Tay is a Scottish river

indicators.note: finally picks the final letter of the word rill

explanation.surface: A stream flows into a larger river.
explanation.definitionFit: A European nation shaped like a boot.

clue.text: Observe daughter becoming one of the top players

parts.note: to see is to observe

explanation.surface: A daughter turns into a star.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranked player in a tournament is placed so the best are kept apart.

clue.text: New singers must engage professional to get under way

indicators.note: to engage is to hold within, so one piece goes inside
new suggests the letters of the word singers are freshly arranged

parts.note: pro is short for professional

explanation.surface: New vocalists hire a pro to get started.
explanation.definitionFit: Something under way is ongoing, being carried out.
